$semantics.planHistory: D13. The workbook has one Monthly Amount for every month: Jan!E22, Dec!E22 and Paycheck Budget!E50 all read Bills!D7. Each is typed here as a row from 2025-01, the month of Paycheck Budget!D6, the earliest month an asserted cell reads it in, and every case resolves it from that history.
$semantics.actuals: F3/D5 and F8. Jan!E21, K21, P21 =SUM(x22:x45) over rows each =Bills!<Monthly Amount>+SUMIFS(Bills!Q:Q, ..., the month). A month with no real row for a bill counts its planned amount. Feb!K21 700 is Credit Card 1's planned 50 plus Student Loan's logged 650, which has no plan. Jan!K21 is 50, not 250: the $200 dated 2025-01-05 is in another year (D10). Weekly Budget!E22 =IF(F22, E50 / 4.333, D50) and L22 =IF(M22, L50 / 4.333, K50), with F22 and M22 unticked, so D50 and K50: E22 counts Rent's plan, its due day 1 being in 2025-01-01..07; L22 is the real $200 in the window, Credit Card 1's due day 14 being outside it.
$semantics.signs: D3: logged payments are positive in Bills!Q and negated in the ledger. Each Actual is as the workbook shows it, positive.
$semantics.not repeated: Jan!D11, Feb!D11 and Dec!D11 are in plan section 5.3's list for this part, but workbook-month-summary has asserted them since S5b, over the same Monthly Amounts now resolved from history; they are not asserted twice.
$semantics.left out: Plan section 5.4. Paycheck Budget!L50 (250), in the same Actual This Month block as E50 and R50, and K50, L22, L21, J19, D11, D15: the workbook adds Credit Card 1's $200 to its $50 plan, where D5 replaces the plan, so under D5 each would differ. Weekly Budget!E50, L50, R50 read the blank $E$6. The month tabs' Transactions-driven cells (U22:U44, P10:P16, U10:U16) are 0 for any engine, the sample's rows being dated 2025. The other cells section 5.4 lists are on sheets this fixture does not read.
